scope: Soundness of the six-speed finite-field support certificate interface. Exact sign, permutation, congruence, and modular-unit transport preserves two distinct signed-triple factors. Six-element supports require one tuple check; five-element supports require every duplicated member; smaller supports are rejected by the terminal. Pure absence of a modular witness yields complete minimum-pair support normalization over the full nonzero raw-residue domain, without assuming a real loneliness bound for those residues. The final theorem derives PrimeTriangleCover from explicit inverse-table, retained-row, and complete support-search checks at threshold 1/6. No concrete prime coverage, prime-product inequality, integer classification, or whole spectrum result is claimed.
